record.paper_title: Open problems from the 12th International Conference on Fuzzy Set Theory and Its Applications
record.original_question: Find a generator for the variety SMV of state MV-algebras. In particular, determine whether such a generator is connected in a natural way with the MV-algebra of the real interval [0,1], analogous to how the state-morphism MV-algebra ([0,1]^2, tau_[0,1]) generates the variety of state morphism MV-algebras.

evidence.quote: Problem 11.1 (A. Dvurecenskij). According to [11, Theorem 5.4 (3)], find a generator of the variety of state MV-algebras. Is this generator connected in some way with the MV-algebra of the real interval?

eg x)=
eg 	au(x)$, (iii) $	au(x\oplus y)=	au(x)\oplus	au(y\ominus (x\wedge y))$, (iv) $	au(	au(x)\oplus	au(y))=	au(x)\oplus	au(y)$, and (v) $	au(	au(x)\wedge	au(y))=	au(x)\wedge	au(y)$. A state MV-algebra is a pair $(M,	au)$ where $M$ is an MV-algebra and $	au$ a state operator. The class SMV of all state MV-algebras forms a variety. A state-morphism MV-algebra is a state MV-algebra in which $	au$ is additionally an MV-algebra endomorphism; the variety SMMV of state-morphism MV-algebras is generated by the single algebra $([0,1]^2,	au_{[0,1]})$, where $[0,1]$ is the standard MV-algebra on the real unit interval and $	au_{[0,1]}(x,y)=(y,y)$.

Exhibit a generator (a single algebra or a class) for the variety SMV of all state MV-algebras. In particular, decide whether there is a generator of SMV that is naturally connected with the standard MV-algebra $[0,1]$ on the real unit interval, in analogy with the way $([0,1]^2,	au_{[0,1]})$ generates the variety SMMV.
artifact.status_search_result: A search of follow-up literature on state MV-algebras and state-morphism MV-algebras locates results identifying generators for the variety of state-morphism MV-algebras and describing subdirectly irreducible state MV-algebras, but no clear citation establishing a single generator of the full variety SMV connected to the standard MV-algebra $[0,1]$ was found. The status of the problem could not be conclusively verified.

status_evidence.title: State morphism MV-algebras
status_evidence.snippet: Description of single generators of the variety of SMMV-algebras and a continuum of varieties of SMMV-algebras.
status_evidence.claim: The variety of state-morphism MV-algebras admits known single generators, but analogous statements for the full SMV variety are not stated.

status_evidence.title: States, state operators and quasi-pseudo-MV algebras
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses state operators on MV-algebras and related varieties.
status_evidence.claim: Continued research on state MV-algebra varieties; no explicit resolution of the SMV-generator problem cited.
